metadata.name: Cell — homeokinetic FAST path (Motor-EPM, reward-free)
metadata.description: Phase 6.8 Stage 1 — the picrawler's reward-free homeokinetic Motor-EPM generalized from 12 leg-joints to 2 flagella (n_legs=1, motor_dim=2), the substrate-flexibility proof. FAST path only: SensorBundle concatenates the motion self-model + collision sensors (imu[4] + whisker_0..5[6] = 10-D) into the homeokinetic state; MotorEPM learns a forward model of its own sensorimotor loop (Der-Martius motor-TLE descent) and acts via the two flagella to keep that loop controllable — alive, exploratory, collision-aware swimming, NO reward. All gait reflexes (coupling/cruse/balance/stroke/height/heading/nav/postural/agency) are OFF; only the homeokinetic core + babble warmup + explore noise run. The slow perception/steering path is added in Stage 2 (the_cell_homeokinetic.json). body_model=differential_paddler + reflex_modular so the 2 outputs are direct per-flagellum thrusts.
